summary: 你和伴侶能一起闖事業，讓對方掌舵最順。
en: The two of you can build a business together, and it works best with your partner at the helm.

summary: 你們夫妻適合合作創業，一起把家業做起來。
en: The two of you are well suited to starting a business together and building up the household side by side.

summary: 你們表面和睦，心卻不在一處，容易漸行漸遠。
en: On the surface you two get along, but your hearts aren't in the same place, and you can easily drift apart.

summary: 你們之間情緒一重，關係就容易起波動。
en: Between the two of you, when feelings run high the relationship easily wobbles.

summary: 你們一開始很親密，相處久了反而容易互不相讓。
en: You start out very close, but over time you can end up refusing to give ground to each other.

summary: 你和伴侶相處和睦，日子過得和美。
en: You and your partner get along well, and life together is harmonious.

summary: 你們的感情來得熱，冷得也快。
en: Your feelings for each other heat up fast and cool just as fast.

summary: 你們兩人一剛一柔最合拍，總要有人肯先讓一步。
en: The two of you work best as one firm, one soft; someone always has to be willing to give way first.

summary: 你和伴侶相處融洽，婚姻和美。
en: You and your partner get along easily, and your marriage is a happy one.

summary: 你們兩人都有自己的想法，容易只顧自己那一邊。
en: You both have your own ideas, and can easily each look after only your own side.

summary: 你們相處守禮，彼此都不會越界。
en: You treat each other with courtesy, and neither crosses the line.

summary: 你們之間容易不和，相處要多費心思。
en: Friction comes easily between you, so the relationship takes extra care.

summary: 你們夫妻和美，相處和睦。
en: You and your partner have a happy, harmonious marriage.

summary: 你們熱戀時很投入，婚後卻容易很快冷下來。
en: You throw yourselves into the romance at first, but after marriage things can cool quickly.

summary: 你們兩人宜各有自己的事業，各自獨立最好。
en: It suits you both to have careers of your own; independence is best.
